title: What FID Hides: Detecting, Ranking, and Diagnosing Deviations in Generative Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2608.24881v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Generative models are commonly ranked by Fr\'echet Inception Distance (FID) and Kernel Inception Distance (KID), yet FID's first-two-moment summary can miss distributional differences, and a reported scalar gap alone is not a calibrated test against sampling variation. FID's moment restriction has concrete consequences: on ImageNet, visually unrecognizable images optimized only to match the reference Inception mean and covariance obtain FID $24.7$ versus $58.6$ for held-out real images (lower is better). Moreover, FID and KID are scalar discrepancies that are unchanged when the two samples are exchanged and therefore do not encode the direction of a dispersion change: under-dispersion, as can occur in mode collapse, versus over-dispersion. translated_title: FID隐藏了什么：生成评估中偏差的检测、排序与诊断
translated_abstract: 生成模型通常通过弗雷歇起始距离（FID）和核起始距离（KID）进行排名，然而FID的前两阶矩摘要可能遗漏分布差异，且报告的标量差距本身并非针对采样变异的校准检验。FID的矩限制具有具体后果：在ImageNet上，仅优化以匹配参考起始均值和协方差的视觉上不可识别的图像，其FID为24.7，而保留的真实图像为58.6（越低越好）。此外，FID和KID是标量差异，当两个样本交换时保持不变，因此不编码离散度变化的方向：欠离散（如模式坍缩中可能出现的）与过离散。我们引入了**ZID**（Z解析综合诊断），它结合了来自秩图（RISE）和高斯核（GPK在两种尺度下）的六个标准化位置和离散度敏感臂。
tldr: 本文提出了ZID诊断方法，通过结合多个统计量来检测、排序和诊断生成评估中FID和KID无法捕捉的分布偏差，特别是离散度方向的变化。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces ZID, a diagnostic method that combines multiple statistics to detect, rank, and diagnose distributional deviations in generative evaluation that FID and KID fail to capture, particularly directional changes in dispersion.
